name: C – Insiders under water
plan: From 9 Nov 2026 (user's go 2026-11-09; until then C traded the hourly ML system, now paper/C/ as a record): the finder's best steady-trading 13/14 candidate that is not A's rule (`3ce4f83a88`, insider_underwater, NOT graduated: it fails only the luck check). Buy an S&P 1500 stock the day it closes at least 29% below the average price an insider paid in open-market purchases filed in the last 90 days (insiders rarely buy to lose: either they were wrong or the stock is a bargain); one signal per stock per 90 days. Stop 3 ATR trailing, out after 60 sessions, 0.4% of equity at risk per trade (the same exits as A). Backtest: about 270 trades a year in 2017-2022 (+0.12R a trade, +57%), about 100 a year in 2023 to mid-2025 (+0.38R a trade, +43%, Sharpe 1.31); positive in all three market regimes. A buys when an insider's purchase is filed; this buys weeks later, only after the price has fallen far below the insider's: on recent filings 1 of its 15 signals was A's stock on the same day. Starts with C's paper equity at the switch; C's MSFT is sold at the next open.
